headline: Callahan's Passage And Nevish Line Press Heavy Frontline Friction
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline volatility has centered heavily on Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line, where fresh base transitions and high casualty rates mark continuous pressure. Callahan's Passage sustained 868 combined losses over the past two hours alongside three base turnovers around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Nevish Line remains acutely divided with four Warden, three Colonial, and one contested neutral position, recording two recent base shifts and over 440 casualties in the last watch. Combat in Mooring County continues at an intense pace with over 700 recent casualties and accelerating troop influx around The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, the blistering casualty rate in Palantine Berm has cooled considerably, though the sector logged three further base exchanges earlier in the period. Elsewhere across the north, Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf maintain substantial casualty drains despite quieted structural movements, and the southern rear lines remain completely undisturbed.
